Ivy Nakamura: massive shoutout to Marcus and Zoe for staying late and triaging the unexpected feature flag drift during the investor demo. You two were calm and fast 10/10 night-owl heroes. :owl: :trophy:

Marcus Reed: thanks! Zoe noticed the flag mismatch in the dashboard at 8:45pm and I pushed a hotfix to re-sync the metadata. weird race between the deploy and the scheduled toggle. :sparkles:

Zoe Patel: also appreciate Theo for keeping an eye on the staging load while we rolled the fix. he bumped up replicas and watched for 20m. :eyes: :muscle:

Ivy Nakamura: the presenter reported no interruption. thats the kind of invisible rescue we love. i'm dropping a tiny bento box on Marcus' desk in the morning as a token (nothing fancy, just good carbs) 1 please help yourselves if you were involved. :bento:

Marcus Reed: tiny repro steps I saved here in case we see the drift again:

Marcus Reed: ```bash
# check for flag drift across regions
curl -s https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/flags/experiment-42 | jq .
ssh infra@staging-2 "kubectl get configmap -n redwood feature-flags -o yaml | grep experiment-42"
```

Zoe Patel: follow-up: i'll add a short check in the deploy pipeline to validate flag parity before promoting. 10min change.

Theo Park: ops-bot recorded the anomalous toggle. i'll write a small watcher to alert on mismatches and send a DM to the release owner so it's noticed earlier.

ops-bot: incident #2168: feature_flag_drift detected. Notified: Marcus Reed, Zoe Patel. Mitigation: resync_metadata. :white_check_mark:

Ivy Nakamura: shoutout pinned. If anyone else had a hand (pairing, testing, moral support), add your name here so I can include you in the weekly kudos email. Also Marcus 1 bento accounted for tomorrow, bring your appetite. :plate_with_cutlery:

Zoe Patel: quick note: i left a one-line changelog in the runbook under "deploy checks" so others can follow the same fix.

Marcus Reed: i'll take the top-right bento. thanks again all 1 makes the late hours worth it. :coffee:
